daily.explanation: Spiders have 8 legs — that's how you know they're not insects. Insects only have 6!

junior.comparison: Same number of legs as two dogs put together.
junior.hint2: More legs than an insect. Insects have 6.
junior.readAloud: How many legs does a spider have?

daily.prompt: How many legs does a spider have?
daily.title: Creepy crawly counting

daily.explanation: Seven colors: Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Indigo, Violet — ROY G. BIV helps you remember.
daily.hint: Try the name ROY G. BIV.

junior.comparison: Same as the number of days in a week.
junior.hint2: A man named ROY G. BIV knows the answer.
junior.readAloud: How many colors are in a rainbow?
junior.superHint: One color for every letter in ROYGBIV.

daily.prompt: How many colors are in a rainbow?
daily.title: Colors in the sky

daily.explanation: A big giraffe is about 18 feet tall — its legs alone are 6 feet, taller than most grown-ups!
daily.hint: Think on the scale of a house.

junior.comparison: About as tall as 3 grown-ups stacked on top of each other.
junior.hint2: Taller than your front door. A LOT taller.
junior.readAloud: How many feet tall is a grown-up giraffe?

daily.prompt: How many feet tall is a grown-up giraffe?
daily.title: Tall, tall, tall

daily.explanation: Grown-ups usually have 32 teeth — including 4 wisdom teeth that show up last.
daily.hint: More than kids have. Kids have 20 baby teeth.

junior.comparison: About as many teeth as there are days in a long month, plus one.
junior.hint2: You have 20 baby teeth. Grown-ups get more than that.
junior.readAloud: How many teeth do grown-ups usually have?

daily.prompt: How many teeth do grown-ups usually have?
daily.title: Say cheese

daily.explanation: Kangaroos live in Australia — the big island country in Oceania. There are more kangaroos there than people!
daily.hint: Look for the big island country below Asia.

junior.comparison: Australia is almost as big as the whole United States.
junior.hint2: It's a country that is also a whole continent.
junior.readAloud: Drop a pin on the country where kangaroos live in the wild.
junior.superHint: Look below Asia, in the bottom right of the map. The country is Australia.

daily.prompt: Drop a pin on the country where kangaroos live in the wild.
daily.title: Pinpoint the place

practice.title: The red planet
practice.prompt: How many moons does Mars have?
practice.hint: Their names mean fear and panic in Greek.
practice.explanation: Mars has 2 small moons, Phobos and Deimos.

junior.readAloud: How many moons does Mars have?
junior.hint2: Fewer than you can count on one hand — way fewer.
junior.comparison: Same as the number of wheels on a bicycle.

practice.title: Strum along
practice.prompt: How many strings does a guitar have?
practice.hint: Count them in the picture in your head — most guitars agree.
practice.explanation: A standard guitar has 6 strings, from low E to high E.

junior.readAloud: How many strings does a guitar have?
junior.hint2: More than a hand of fingers.
junior.comparison: Same as the number of legs on an insect.

practice.title: The biggest animal ever
practice.prompt: How many feet long is a blue whale?
practice.explanation: Blue whales reach about 80 feet — the largest animal known to have ever lived.

junior.readAloud: How many feet long is a blue whale?
junior.hint2: Longer than two school buses parked end to end.
junior.comparison: About as long as 13 grown-ups lying head to toe.

practice.title: On the field
practice.prompt: How many players does one soccer team have on the field?
practice.explanation: Each soccer team fields 11 players, including the goalkeeper.

junior.readAloud: How many players does one soccer team have on the field at one time?
junior.hint2: More than a basketball team (5), less than two basketball teams plus a referee.
junior.comparison: Two basketball teams' worth of players, plus one goalie.

practice.title: Pinpoint the place
practice.prompt: Drop a pin on the country where giant pandas live in the wild.
practice.hint: Look for the big country in eastern Asia.
practice.explanation: Giant pandas live wild only in the mountains of central China.

junior.readAloud: Drop a pin on the country where giant pandas live in the wild.
junior.hint2: It's a huge country in Asia — the one with the Great Wall.
junior.superHint: The country is China, in the upper right part of the map.
junior.comparison: China is about the same size as the whole United States.
